sources.title: The Block — Lighter launches native token LIT, allocates half to ecosystem growth (published 30 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 30 Dec 2025. Allocation: 50% ecosystem (incl. immediate airdrop of 25% of FDV to points seasons 1–2 and future incentives/partnerships), 26% team, 24% investors; team and investors under a one-year lock and three-year linear vesting. Team: value from all Lighter products 'will fully accrue to LIT holders'; revenue trackable on-chain, used for growth and buybacks. Token issued directly by Lighter's US C-Corp, which operates the protocol 'at cost'; staking tiers planned. LIT ~$2.34 on launch morning vs ~$3.25 pre-market. Lighter November volume $292.5B vs Aster $259.2B.

sources.title: Whale Alert — Lighter launches LIT token: 25% airdropped, 50% team/investors with 1-year lock and 3-year vesting (30 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 30 Dec 2025. 25% of supply airdropped immediately to season 1–2 points holders (part of the 50% ecosystem share); team 26% and investors 24% locked one year, then linear vesting over three years. Revenues to be split between growth and buybacks depending on market conditions. LIT issued by Lighter's US C-Corp.

sources.title: Foresight News (via MEXC) — With Lighter TGE imminent, market expects FDV above $2B? (30 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 30 Dec 2025, pre-launch. Total supply 1 billion LIT; airdrop 25% = 250M LIT. Pre-market LIT perp at $3.46, FDV above $3B. Lighter platform 24h volume $2.147B.

sources.title: CoinDesk (via MEXC) — Traders split over whether Lighter's LIT clears $3B FDV after launch (30 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 30 Dec 2025. Pre-market ~$3.20 per CoinMarketCap (FDV >$3B); Polymarket ~even odds of >$3B FDV a day after launch. Dune: Lighter averaged ~$2.7B daily perp volume over the prior week.

sources.title: MEXC News — Coinbase lists Lighter token as LIT nears $3 on launch day (30 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Launch-day report (TGE 30 Dec 2025; page itself undated). Coinbase said LIGHTER-USD spot trading would go live once liquidity conditions are met. About 25% of the 1B LIT supply circulating at TGE. LIT traded just under $3, then $2.7–2.9.

sources.title: The Block — Lighter's LIT token rises 14% as protocol indicates active buyback (5 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 5 Jan 2026. Lighter said fees and buybacks can be tracked via the treasury account (Account #0) in its block explorer; at 10pm ET 5 Jan it held 180,588 LIT (~$549k). Buyback not formally confirmed; no amounts or prices published. LIT ~$3.04. Lighter reported >$200B December volume (Aster $177.5B, Hyperliquid $169.3B). Public mainnet launched October 2025.

sources.title: The Block — Lighter introduces mandatory LIT staking for liquidity pool access (14 Jan 2026, 21:52 EST)
sources.excerpt: Published 14 Jan 2026 21:52 EST (02:52 UTC 15 Jan) — the last pre-listing snapshot used. 1 staked LIT unlocks up to 10 USDC of LLP deposits; existing LLP depositors must stake by 28 Jan. Staking ≥100 LIT waives withdrawal/transfer fees; staking APR undisclosed. Fees for market makers/HFT rising with LIT-staking discounts; retail stays free. LIT $2.07 (−2.56% 24h). December volume >$200B.

sources.title: The Block — Lighter raises $68 million at a $1.5 billion valuation (11 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 11 Nov 2025. $68M round at ~$1.5B valuation (single source with knowledge of the matter), led by Founders Fund and Ribbit Capital with Haun Ventures and Robinhood; round included token warrants. On-chain perp volume hit a record $1.2T in October 2025; perps >56% of DEX volume in 2025.

sources.title: 0xJermo (Substack) — The thesis: Lighter (2 Jan 2026; author holds LIT, team gave feedback)
sources.excerpt: Published 2 Jan 2026. Conflict: author holds LIT and Lighter reviewed the draft. Annualised fees ~$132.5M (DefiLlama). Fee model: standard accounts 0/0 fees with latency delays; premium accounts pay maker 0.002 / taker 0.02 (%) for lower latency. OI ~$1.55B (CoinGlass). CEO quoted: TVL 'consolidating around $1.5 billion' (undated). Founder Vladimir Novakovski: Harvard at 18, Citadel, Head of ML at Quora, VP Eng at Addepar. '23 of 28 engineers' olympiad winners. Backers listed: a16z, Coatue, Coinbase, Craft, Dragonfly, Founders Fund, Haun, Lightspeed, Ribbit, Robinhood. Buyback share and timing at team discretion; LIT not yet withdrawable from Lighter, so off-platform LIT may be IOUs; team says it won't pay for listings.

sources.title: OneKey blog — Lighter's TGE is imminent: what valuation counts as reasonable? (22 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Figures 'current as of 22 Dec 2025' from DefiLlama: annualised protocol revenue near ~$200M; 30-day perp volume ~$259B; TVL ~$1.46B. Base-case FDV range $2.2–3.6B.

sources.title: Bitquery DEXrabbit — LIT (Lighter) token on Ethereum
sources.excerpt: ERC-20 'Lighter' (LIT) at 0x232ce3bd40fcd6f80f3d55a522d03f25df784ee2; total supply 1B. No information on mint/owner roles. Only static contract facts were read from this live page; market data on it was ignored.

price_usd.note: last dated pre-listing price found (14 Jan 2026 21:52 EST)

circulating_supply.note: 25% airdrop at TGE (LIT-03). Any ecosystem-reserve tokens already released (e.g. LIT reportedly paid to a market maker, LIT-08) are not in this figure — no provider snapshot dated ≤15 Jan was available.

team_vesting_months.note: 1-year lock then 3-year linear (LIT-02). Some write-ups say '1-year cliff, 3-year vesting', which could mean 36 months total; the vesting contract was not read.

unlock_90d_pct_of_circ.note: scheduled team/investor tranches only: the lock runs to ~30 Dec 2026. The remaining ~25% ecosystem reserve (250M LIT = 100% of circulating) has no published release schedule and can be distributed at the team's discretion — not counted here, flagged under K09.

unlock_12m_pct_of_circ.note: team+investor 500M vesting linearly over 36 months from ~30 Dec 2026: ~7.3M LIT by 15 Jan 2027 = 2.9% of 250M circulating. Excludes the undisclosed ecosystem-reserve schedule (see K09) and assumes no cliff release.

price_to_last_round_multiple.note: listing FDV $2.07B vs ~$1.5B Nov-2025 equity valuation (round included token warrants; warrant terms not public)

tvl_usd.note: ≈$1.4B before the airdrop (Bubblemaps, LIT-08) less ~$101M net outflow in the first 24h. LIT-18 says 'over $1.2B'; LIT-17 had $1.46B on 22 Dec.

annualized_fees_usd.note: DefiLlama annualised fees as quoted 2 Jan 2026. Other estimates: ~$200M revenue run-rate (LIT-17, 22 Dec), ~$105M (LIT-18, undated).

annualized_revenue_usd.note: fees are charged by the protocol (no LP fee split; LLP earns from market-making, not fees), so revenue ≈ fees; operator costs ('at cost', LIT-01) are not disclosed

category_share_pct.note: share of DEX perp market at end-2025 (KuCoin Ventures); Lighter led monthly volume in Nov and Dec (LIT-01, LIT-06), but OI ~$1.4B vs Hyperliquid ~$8B
